## Weekly digest (automation B)
Sundays **10:00 AM UTC** (cron `0 10 * * 0`, workflow timezone set). Reads this week's posts from the blog API; no posts = stops, no message. qwq writes one-two sentences per post (titles and links come from the API, never the model), then hands the post to Agent 5, which publishes and announces it like any post (slug `weekly-digest-YYYY-MM-DD`, so a rerun updates the same digest).

**Dry run:** run with input `{"dryRun": true}`.
